How to classify a franchise

Identify the employer responsible for managing and supervising the workplace. If an independent franchisee operates a single workplace, choose Standalone. If it operates multiple sites, choose Head Office or Branch within the franchisee’s own establishment. Choose Branch for a location operated as a unit of the same employer. Check the franchise and employment arrangements if responsibility is shared or unclear.
